translations.answer: Verify the semantics of both actuators: whether explicit torque calculation is used, whether the solver implicitly applies PD control, and whether torque limits and delay models are consistent. Comments indicate that Isaac Lab can be replaced with a DC/delay motor, so differences cannot be attributed solely to the platform; an A/B test should be conducted under the same time step, limit settings, and joint model.
